conversations_group_name_chk.name: conversations_group_name_chk
conversations_group_name_chk.value: "conversations"."kind" = 'direct' or ("conversations"."name" is not null and char_length("conversations"."name") between 1 and 64)

message_keys_envelope_chk.name: message_keys_envelope_chk
message_keys_envelope_chk.value: ("message_keys"."version" = 1 and "message_keys"."ephemeral_public_key" is not null and "message_keys"."ratchet_public_key" is null) or ("message_keys"."version" = 2 and "message_keys"."ephemeral_public_key" is null and "message_keys"."ratchet_public_key" is not null and "message_keys"."previous_chain_length" is not null and "message_keys"."message_number" is not null)

message_keys_distribution_chk.name: message_keys_distribution_chk
message_keys_distribution_chk.value: ("message_keys"."distribution_ciphertext" is null and "message_keys"."distribution_nonce" is null) or ("message_keys"."distribution_ciphertext" is not null and "message_keys"."distribution_nonce" is not null)

message_keys_x3dh_chk.name: message_keys_x3dh_chk
message_keys_x3dh_chk.value: ("message_keys"."sender_identity_public_key" is null and "message_keys"."signed_pre_key_id" is null) or ("message_keys"."sender_identity_public_key" is not null and "message_keys"."signed_pre_key_id" is not null)

messages_sender_key_chk.name: messages_sender_key_chk
messages_sender_key_chk.value: ("messages"."sender_key_id" is null and "messages"."sender_key_iteration" is null) or ("messages"."sender_key_id" is not null and "messages"."sender_key_iteration" is not null)

users_credential_chk.name: users_credential_chk
users_credential_chk.value: "users"."password_hash" is not null or "users"."oauth_subject" is not null
